text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has assessed the feasibility of and is recommending the installation of speed bumps in the first north-south public lane east of Coxwell Avenue, between Plains Road and O'Connor Drive

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed bumps in the first north-south public lane east of Coxwell Avenue, between Plains Road and O'Connor Drive, as shown on Drawing 421G-2958 attached to the report (May 18, 2018) from the Acting Director, Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District.
